question: Where should the practitioner perform the rite if earlier locations are unavailable?
premises: The earlier locations may be absent.
The ground of the ancestors is specified as an alternative.
The speaker declares this to the addressee.
inference: If those locations are unavailable, the rite may be performed on the ground of the ancestors.
uncertainties: vāsāṃsi may mean dwellings or garments depending on context.
plain_english: In the absence of those, I tell you, on the ground of the ancestors are the places to dwell.
